festivals.notes: Tihar public holiday — Laxmi Puja to Bhai Tika. Starts on the Laxmi Puja day (pradosh-vyapini Amavasya) and ends on the Bhai Tika day (`end_at`), so the span is 3–5 days as the tithis fall.
Deepawali, Aausi. The lamps are lit in pradosh kaal, so the day is the one Amavasya pervades the first fifth of the night — 2022-10-24, whose Amavasya opens at 17:43, minutes after sunset.
Gai Tihar — morning observance on the same civil day as Laxmi Puja, so it follows the same pradosh-vyapini Amavasya.

solar_corrections.ishtakaal_note_en: Listed sunrise/sunset are computed from the observer's own latitude and longitude, so Deshaantar and Akshamsha are already inherent; do not apply them again for Ishtakaal. Belaantar is shown for reference only.
solar_corrections.ishtakaal_note_ne: सूचीबद्ध सूर्योदय/अस्त स्थानको वास्तविक अक्षांश र देशान्तरबाट गणना गरिएको हो — इष्टकाल गणनामा पुनः देशान्तर वा अक्षांश थप्नु पर्दैन। बेलान्तर सन्दर्भका लागि मात्र देखाइएको हो।
